text:
elaine: Vendor delivered pen-test report (link https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-report). Summary: 3 findings (RBAC over-privilege, KMS access audit gaps, and log retention/sampling). Need ops + infra input on what proof the vendor requires and how to package artifacts for retest. @samir @mike can you advise on (1) RBAC change window + scoped role, (2) KMS audit export + key rotation proof, (3) log slice from aggregator. Prefer limited ephemeral changes, not org-wide IAM edits. Planning retest next week if we can assemble artifacts.

samir: I can own the ephemeral role. Proposed change window: Tue 2025-06-10 13:00-15:00 UTC. Plan: create assessor role with minimal privileges (S3 read on pt-artifacts prefix + KMS describe/rotation status). We'll avoid kms:Decrypt unless vendor absolutely needs it. Example policy snippet I plan to attach:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-artifacts/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:DescribeKey","kms:GetKeyRotationStatus"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE"]}
  ]
}
```
Will open a short CR/PR for approvers.

mike: +1 on ephemeral. Suggest pulling logs from the aggregator (Datadog/ELK) instead of raw S3 — easier to slice and redact. Olga can you export events for 2025-06-01..2025-06-07 and include CloudTrail and application access logs? Note: audit retention policy archives >90d; verify the relevant timeframe is hot.

olga: I can do exports. I'll prepare an artifact bundle and upload presigned links valid 7 days. Commands I'll use for KMS proof:
`aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key-id>`
`aws kms list-aliases --key-id <key-id>`
For CloudTrail lookup: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:...`. I'll include CloudTrail JSON slices and an index file explaining which files map to report findings. I will name the zip: redwood_pt_artifacts_1769999999.zip and post links here.

security-bot: Intake ticket created SEC-2025-234 and assigned to eng-security oncall. Reminder: any RBAC change that affects compute must have one SRE reviewer on the CR. See https://redwood.internal/runbooks/change-windows

samir: We'll avoid cluster-level IAM changes. Role will be assumable only by vendor principal, limited time window, and we'll revoke afterwards. I'll add rollback steps in the CR and note exact ARNs to revoke.

elaine: Sounds good. Olga please upload by EOD so we can lock retest. Proposed retest target Wed 2025-06-11 14:00 UTC if all artifacts are ready. If anything blocks, escalate to @infra oncall. :thumbsup:

olga: Uploading now — will post presigned links and a short manifest when done.

mike: Confirmed we can slice events from Datadog. Will paste the query and a screenshot of the slice here in thread.

samir: Vendor also asked for alias mapping and grant history for the impacted key. I'll export alias list + any outstanding grants and include in the bundle: `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key-id>`

elaine: Thanks all. Action items recap: Samir create role + CR and export alias/grants; Olga upload artifact bundle and presigned links; Mike export aggregator slice and provide query; Security-bot ticket SEC-2025-234 is tracking. We'll use this thread as our single source of truth for retest scheduling and artifact verification. If timeline holds, retest Wed 2025-06-11 14:00 UTC.
